summary: hashicorp.vault authenticates through environment variables injected by credentials rather than module parameters. Supported: AppRole (VAULT_APPROLE_ROLE_ID and VAULT_APPROLE_SECRET_ID env vars via a custom credential type, or role_id/secret_id task parameters with auth_method: approle) and token (VAULT_TOKEN).
questions: Which authentication methods does hashicorp.vault support?
Which environment variables does hashicorp.vault read?
Can I pass role_id and secret_id directly to hashicorp.vault tasks?
